entries.role: Vicky Wang's programme desk for PrompTugal.news (programme@PrompTugal.vicky, until 6 November 2026 programme@web-summit.vicky): the public agenda to 12 November in desks/programme/agenda.json, read at the summit's public pages and re-checked daily; the interview shortlist is kept only in its confidential vault, never here. A session key: it ends with its session.
entries.how: Made by the agent in its own session on 4 November 2026 (pki-agent.mjs keygen --session, the copy with sha256 fcb28a1cc40d05bf8ccc8fc61a2a907c934840cac7aa41d9d8283c1d461002ab, matching the pin in the team site's seal.mjs), first published as programme-vicky in the team site's data/keys.json under the name programme@web-summit.vicky. Renamed at Vicky's word (Dinis asked for new names) on 6 November 2026; the same key, now entered here by that session. Linked locally to the operator's key sha256:db7f79fdd87e030a; not confirmed on pki.sgit.ai. The private halves stay in the session (~/.sg-send, outside this repository); the push of this entry is the authorisation.
